contexts.text: One (Angel) loves another more than himself. AC 1594:end. AC 2057:2. AC 4286. AC 6711. SE 3906. SE 4046:end.
The more who come there, the happier they are...
Many Christians who have led an evil life.
The celestial love the neighbour more than themselves.
The more there are, the better is the correspondence; because perfection and strength are from the unanimous multitude of many...
The natural Angels do not love others more than themselves.
The deliverance of many from Hell. Signified, Explained.
In proportion as there are more (or many) in one Society... the more perfect is its human form. Explained. LJ 12.
Conjugial love not possible between one husband and a number of wives.
So that from many (Churches) it makes one.
He who in the life of the body loves the neighbour as himself, in the other life loves the neighbour more than himself. See AC 548.
2. These receive more of light... But this more is an apparent more; for they are not more wise than in so far as the love with them makes a one with the wisdom.
